core_obligations: Base case k = 0: choose the section prescribed at the points by the values lemma and take F' equal to the whole space, so the codimension condition is vacuous (proof lines 38831-38837).
Induction step: apply the induction hypothesis with the bound decreased by one to get a section u and a closed set G satisfying the conditions for the original data (proof lines 38838-38845).

Decompose G into irreducible components, discard those contained in F, and for each remaining component pick a point in it outside F and outside the other components; since the bound gives room, choose at that point an element not in the span of the values of the given sections (proof lines 38846-38855).

Apply the induction hypothesis again, now with one more section u, the closed set F union G, the old points with value zero and the new points with the chosen values, and the bound decreased by one, obtaining a section t and a closed set H (proof lines 38856-38865).

Choose an element f equal to one at the points of the components of G and zero at the points of the components of H not inside F union G, and set the section equal to u plus f t (proof lines 38866-38870).

Verify the three conditions: the values at the prescribed points are unchanged because t vanishes there; the vanishing locus of the extended family is contained in F union H; and no component of that locus of codimension at most k minus one can occur, because it would have to be a component of G or of H, and in both cases the chosen element at the corresponding point makes the value of the new section independent of the old ones (proof lines 38871-38917).
proof_roadmap: Induct on the codimension bound, settling the case of the bound equal to zero by prescribing values (proof lines 38831-38837).
Use the induction hypothesis once to get a section and a closed set with bound one smaller (proof lines 38838-38845).
Pick test points on the components of that closed set and values outside the span of the old sections (proof lines 38846-38855).
Use the induction hypothesis a second time with one more section and the larger closed set, obtaining a second section and closed set (proof lines 38856-38865).
Separate the two families of points by an element of the ring, perturb, and check the vanishing locus and the codimension bound component by component (proof lines 38866-38917).
difficulty_reason: statement 是「在 Noetherian 拓扑空间的框架下，给定若干给定截面与闭集 F 及维数条件 (*)，可再添一个截面 s，使它在指定点取指定值、其零点集被 F 并一个 F' 盖住、且 F' 的每个不可约分支余维 ≥ k」。证明是对 k 的双重归纳，结构清楚、每一步都可复核：先用一次归纳假设得到 u 与 G，在 G 的每个分支上挑点并选一个不在旧截面值张成里的 w_j；再用一次归纳假设（多一个截面 u、闭集取 F∪G）得到 t 与 H；然后用中国剩余型引理挑出在 y_j 取值 1、在 z_l 取值 0 的 f，令 s=u+ft；最后逐个排除「余维 ≤ k-1 的分支」两种可能，靠挑选的 w_j 与 z_l 处的独立性收尾。承重演算（两次归纳的使用、f 的存在性、逐分支的独立性检查）都在 span 内；共 5 处引用，其中 2 处是 Topology 的 section、1 处 Algebra 引理，另有同章 situation 与「取指定值」引理各 1 处。**statement 依赖的 situation-splitting（38720-38728）已作为 context span 收进卡内**（reader 能看到 M、V(x)、维数函数是什么），label 在包内自解析。statement 的 reference 环境里 1 处 \cite（Serre）落在 comment 型环境内，不参与编译、无需书目。
